title: Extend a replacement stage with its prescribed finite map
statement: For a qcqs scheme X, an étale hypercover K of X, r≥0 and a finite split replacement stage R through degree r over K, there exist a full finite split étale hypercover V, a refinement V→K and an isomorphism trunc_r(V)≅R.U carrying the truncated refinement to R.f.

proof.text: Iterate the proved successor-stage extension starting at R. Induction on the tower index shows every later stage restricts to R at degree r. Restrict its diagonal to obtain stages in every degree with compatible literal restrictions, then use tower assembly retaining truncations. The tower equality at r identifies the resulting finite truncation with R. Transport the refinement equality through this equality; the resulting equality-to-isomorphism gives the required finite identification.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_replacement_stage
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hK : IsEtaleHypercover K) (r : ℕ)
    (R : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K r) :
    ∃ (V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (f : V.simplicial ⟶ K)
      (e : (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj V.simplicial ≅ R.U.simplicial),
      (SimplicialObject.truncation r).map f = e.hom ≫ R.f
